title: Decode a GOP once for a pending exact-preview batch

definition.title: Decode a GOP once for a pending exact-preview batch
definition.source_excerpt: Question. Can multiple already-pending thumbnail requests share decoding while still returning every exact requested image? This is neither dropping superseded scrub requests nor relying on cache hits. Twelve requested frames between indices 123 and 177 lie in one closed GOP of the same H.264 source. The baseline launches twelve independent accurate-seek jobs. The candidate seeks once to that GOP and emits the requested frames. An independent full-decode-from-start path serves as a third oracle. All twelve output hashes agree across all three paths. Median CPU is 1761.90 → 213.58 ms; wall time is 1312.43 → 139.23 ms. Process count falls from twelve to one. The measured reduction combines process launch, probing, seeking and repeated decode avoidance; it is not a claim that the decoder itself becomes eight times faster. An already-persistent Wasm decoder would have a different baseline.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse.
definition.minimum_probe: One short owned source and a few target requests under equal memory budgets, with an independent full-decode/reference result.
definition.initial_screen: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse. One short owned source and a few target requests under equal memory budgets, with an independent full-decode/reference result.
definition.primary_metric: Time to the requested exact or explicitly approximate preview, total prerequisite work and retained state.
definition.scope_contract: Correct source/time/target and agreed fidelity. Approximate results cannot populate exact caches or qualify normal playback.
definition.negative_control: Move backward, request a non-RAP dependency, change source or cancel a pending request; stale previews must never become current.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop at E3 preview/index/state infrastructure. Keep proof of a bounded mechanism distinct from a production preview implementation.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Existing preview or decoder access path. Its absence is setup cost, not permission to create a complete preview service.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

prepare.basis: Implemented a browser owner for seven already-pending exact consumers (including duplicate frame13) in one closed720p48-picture GOP. Decodeonce candidate returns an independently owned VideoFrame clone perconsumer, all hostFFmpeg I420 hashes/PTS exact. Canceling one queuedconsumer suppresses only that output; six survivors remainexact. Different-source, nonpending andout-of-index jobs reject; allframes/decoderclose andpeakownership<=16. Baseline is one persistentVideoDecoder object reset/configured perrequest, not sevenprocesslaunches. Candidate submits38packets vs152 baseline, without wait-to-fill, approximate selection, droppedduplicate orcachehit. Nine alternating wholeownerpairs include config/decode/clone/copy/hash/reset/flush/close: 301.467→213.600ms, saving29.15%,95%[25.627240149897755, 31.985735468520282], passes10%lower-boundgate. Fixedpreparedsame-source/configclosedGOP; source-epoch changes are rejected/fallback boundaries, not cross-source sharing or integratedplayer admission.
